sentences.text:
Coram:Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar,Judge
 Order

The petitioner has challenged order 29th June, 2024, whereby, during pendency of reference under Section 18 and 31 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, the learned District Judge has made an order for release of amount of compensation deposited by the Collector with the said 2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that it was not open to the learned Reference Court to direct release of amount of compensation without first deciding the issue relating to entitlement of the concerned parties to the amount of compensation.

3. Issue notice to the respondent Nos.5 to 8 in the first instance.
4.
Mr. J. H. Reshi, Advocate, who is on caveat, waives notice on behalf of respondent Nos.5 to 8.
He seeks time to file reply to the writ petition.
Needful be done by the next date of hearing.
